about: Held-out set 2, locked 2026-11-24 before any run. Three new synthetic projects (EN, HY, RU), 120 cases, written in a session that did not author T4 and did not open eval/t4 results, eval/dev cases or eval/heldout cases. One lexical run (eval/heldout2/lexical.sh) and one T4 run (run.py) per set; run.py refuses a mismatch and never reruns a set. Any change here, to a set file, to the code listed or to a model digest invalidates held-out claims.
